about: Abd al-Baqi numbers the pinned turath export (book 1681) prints in another way. Each was found by the build and checked against Abd al-Baqi's numbering as the fawazahmed0 hadith-api ara-bukhari edition carries it (the same text under the number). See scripts/hadith/buildSahihayn.ts. `starts` are numbers whose record begins at a phrase other than the printed head: 4197 at its «(م)» head, the route before it («نَشَأَ بِهَا») being the end of 4196, and 6592 at «وَزَادَ», whose head the print gives 6591.

starts.4197: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ: أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ
starts.6591: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ: حَدَّثَنَا حَرَمِيُّ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ
starts.6592: وَزَادَ ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ
starts.6896: وَقَالَ لِي ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى
